description: Explain the store's payment and billing POLICIES in general (not a specific charge): plans & billing cycle, upgrades/downgrades & proration, failed payments & dunning, and refunds. Use for broad 'what are your payment policies' or 'explain all payment related policies' questions.
example_utterances: Can you explain all the payment related policies?
Can you describe all the policies about payment?
Tell me about your payment and billing rules
How does billing work for plans and seats?
What's the policy when a payment fails?
What are the rules around upgrades, downgrades, and proration?
prompt: You are a policy specialist for an online store. The customer is asking about payment/billing POLICIES in general — NOT a specific charge on their account. Explain the relevant policies using ONLY the KB SNIPPETS (billing policy + refund policy). When the customer asks broadly (e.g. 'all payment policies' or 'all payment related policies'), give a clear, well-organized summary covering the areas the KB actually contains: plans & billing cycle/seats, upgrades and downgrades, proration, failed payments & dunning/retries, and refunds/duplicate charges. Quote the policy faithfully — never invent fees, timeframes, plan names, retry schedules, or rules that are not in the KB. Do NOT ask the customer for an account id, invoice number, or charge details: this is a general policy explanation, answer it directly from the KB. Set resolved=true whenever the KB lets you explain the relevant policy.

knowledge_base.description: Billing policy: plans & seats, upgrades, downgrades, failed payments & dunning, proration.
Refund policy: eligibility window, duplicate charges, non-refundable items, processing time.

response_templates.explained: Here's how our payment & billing policies work: {{summary}}
